map.灯光总功率与负载计算 使用指南: Lighting Total Power and Load Calculator User Guide
map.添加多个灯具及其功率，计算舞台灯光总功率、总电流与三相负载分配，用于配电容量规划: Add several fixtures with their power to compute total stage lighting power, total current and three-phase load distribution, used for distribution capacity planning, breaker selection and electrical safety checks.
map.演出前汇总各灯具功率与数量，算总功率、总电流，校核供电容量与断路器是否够用。: Before a show, total up the power and quantity of each fixture to get total power and current, and check whether the supply capacity and breakers are enough.
map.三相负载应尽量均衡分配，单相大功耗设备（追光、烟雾机）单独回路，控制每相不平衡度: Distribute three-phase loads as evenly as possible, give high-power single-phase equipment (such as a follow spot or a smoke machine) its own circuit, and control the unbalance of each phase.
map.按总电流预留安全裕度（如 20%）并向上取整选断路器，避免满负载跳闸。: Reserve a safety margin on the total current (such as 20%) and round up when choosing a breaker, so a full load does not trip.
map.算例：典型舞台灯阵（380V 三相）: Worked example: a typical stage lighting rig (380V three-phase)
map.：灯具清单：LED 帕灯 200W×24、电脑摇头灯 700W×8、卤素聚光 1: Luminaire list: LED par cans 200W x 24, moving-head lights 700W x 8, halogen spotlights 1000W x 12 (three-phase), follow spots 2500W x 2 and smoke machines 1500W x 2 (single-phase). Total power 30.40 kW (22.40 kW three-phase, 8.00 kW single-phase) across 48 units. At 380V three-phase, a power factor of 0.9 and a 20% safety margin: total current is about 51.3 A, about 53.0 A per phase, and about 61.6 A after the margin, so a 64 A breaker is advised; single-phase accounts for about 26.3%.
map.三相和单相电流怎么算？: How Are Three-Phase and Single-Phase Currents Calculated?
map.三相总电流 = 总功率 / (√3 × 电压 × 功率因数)；单相设备电流 =: Three-phase total current = total power / (sqrt(3) x voltage x power factor); single-phase equipment current = power / (voltage x power factor). Three-phase loads should be split across the three phases and added to the single-phase circuits.
map.为什么建议总负载不超过断路器 80%？: Why Is Total Load Recommended to Stay Below 80% of the Breaker?
map.留裕度可应对灯具启动冲击与温升，降低跳闸与线路过热风险；长期满负荷会加速绝缘老化: Leaving a margin handles fixture inrush and temperature rise, cutting tripping and cable overheating risk; running at full load for long periods accelerates insulation ageing.
